summary: Retain bounded local fault evidence when an experimental shared replica payload exceeds the actual encoded cap.

replay.detail: No startup scan or repair is introduced. Pending evidence after restart remains uncertified; known committed fault evidence blocks ordinary re-sealing.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, user_version or migrations change. Experimental new batches add local-only meta markers and a bounded summary, then local-only fault keys on sealing failure; these metadata operations are not included in claim or envelope wire payloads.

rules.detail: Checkpoint selection and RULES_VERSION are unchanged. Expiry, trim or deletion of implicated rows does not resolve retained fault evidence.

compatibility.detail: Adds a smallclaims bounded fault-read API and typed sealing failure. Default-off ordinary appends retain their serial behavior; experimental marked payloads are checked using actual complete serialized CBOR, including claim signatures, before sealing commits.

downtime.detail: No new restart pause is introduced with grouping disabled. If experimental grouping is enabled and a cap fault occurs, ordinary sealing stops and retains evidence; operator repair/clear and already-sealed-marker recovery are not implemented in this draft.

manual.detail: Keep grouping disabled. Exact pre-append metadata admission, explicit same-incarnation repair, deployed old-node compatibility and copied-store post-dedupe latency proofs remain required before enabling.

recovery.detail: On oversize, the entire sealing chunk rolls back, then the same loan separately commits bounded evidence. Evidence COMMIT failure retains the observation in memory and leaves durable pending markers; restart cannot report verified. No supported fault-clear procedure is claimed yet.
